fixture_policy.empty_case: zero rows with a valid empty snapshot checksum
fixture_policy.redaction_case: one synthetic row with secret/token/content values replaced by typed redaction markers
fixture_policy.abnormal_case: reference or state drift is rejected with a bounded failure classification
fixture_policy.scope: Executable synthetic projected-row contract vectors, not full SQL rows or production collector/normalizer output. Field lengths on fixture-only TEXT projections are bounded test limits. Raw passwords, keys and provider locations are never included. Remaining columns require P0a collector coverage.
fixture_policy.checksum: sha256 of UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted ASCII object keys; arrays keep order; decimal monetary values are strings. This is a synthetic row checksum, not schema_hash.
fixture_policy.target_policy: Synthetic least-privilege target allows user role and two read scopes only. Each real restore must bind reviewed target policy, identity mappings and exact secret versions; disabling credentials never authorizes writes to a live installation.
